production.source: Original approved RGB with an alpha matte. Fringe cleanup affects the outer transparent edge.
production.head: Registered original reference pixels on a close-traced head matte. Used for unaltered jaw and native hair in moving frames.
production.cape: Fully illustrated occluded cape fabric derived from the matching underlay, registered to the original clasp.
production.torsos: Generated transparent neck-to-pelvis armor plates matched to the approved blue/gold and violet/gold outfits. Row 1 includes a gold star and row 2 is emblem-free. The four cells are 240 by 320.
production.emblems: Six isolated illustrated gold badges in 96 by 96 cells. Row 1 contains star, bolt and shield. Row 2 contains leaf, sun and wave.
